branding.body: Your logo and an accent color that stays accessible.

api.secretRotated: New client secret (the previous one keeps working for 24 hours)

sandbox.copied: Copied: settings, roles, organization structure, custom fields, policies, workflows, approval chains, time off types and policies, schedule templates and branding.
sandbox.notCopied: Never copied: people, users, documents, absences, timesheets, the audit log, sign-in methods, API keys, webhooks and audit streams.

customBranding.description: Your logo and accent color in the app.

branding.lead: Show your logo and use your accent color for links and buttons.
branding.resetDone: Accent color reset to the default.
branding.accentBody: To keep the app readable for everyone, the color must meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on every background, in light and dark mode.
branding.separateDark: Use a different color in dark mode
branding.rejected: This color was not saved because it does not have enough contrast:

off.body: Your organization has not turned on the Ask HR assistant. Contact HR with your question.

settings.body: Ask HR lets employees ask questions about your policies. It answers only from the policy documents you choose, cites them, and tells people they are talking to AI. It never makes or recommends employment decisions, such as hiring, pay, performance, promotion, discipline or termination. It is off until you turn it on.

refusal.employment_decision: I can't make or recommend decisions about people, such as hiring, pay, performance ratings, promotion, discipline, termination or layoffs. I can explain what your company's policies say about these processes. For a decision, speak to HR or the manager responsible.

askHr.disclosure: You are talking to an AI assistant. It answers only from your company's policy documents and can make mistakes, so check the cited source. It never makes or recommends decisions about hiring, pay, performance, promotion, discipline or termination.
